value.signature: fn dependency_status (records : & ValidatedRecords , edge : & EdgeId) -> Result < DependencyStatus , ValidationError >

review.body: { let reference = PublicReference :: Edge (edge . clone ()) ; let result = if ! valid_id (& edge . act) { Err (ValidationError :: InvalidReference (reference)) } else if let Some (act) = records . acts . iter () . chain (records . history . acts . iter ()) . find (| act | act . legs . iter () . any (| leg | & leg . id == edge)) { Ok (match & act . projections . dependency { DependencyProjection :: FullEmpty => DependencyStatus :: FullEmpty , DependencyProjection :: Full (_) => DependencyStatus :: Full , DependencyProjection :: Tombstoned (position) => DependencyStatus :: Tombstoned (* position) , }) } else { Err (ValidationError :: UnresolvedReference (reference)) } ; if result . is_err () { refused () ; } result }
review.item_premise: Derives an existing structural leg status from the owning whole act in the private validated snapshot. No leg stores its own removal or status field; malformed and missing identities refuse explicitly.
